mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carts (user_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id, p.name, p.price, c.quantity, pi.img_url FROM carts c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON p.id = pi.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, recipient, phone, address, total_price) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recipient}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{totalPrice})
